canon_hooks.native_excerpt: "The evil lizard lives nearby, in a big cave with a hole at the top. The rain falls into the hole. It's a good cave, dark and wet, and it used to be very quiet. She's always out hunting, she flies over the island all the time! And the cave just stands there empty!"
